notes.title: Chapatriste launch date delayed.
notes.notes:
Launch delay.

Happy Tuesday! Due to last-minute technical problems, Chapatriste launch date has been delayed by two weeks (it is no longer happy Tuesday). 

We want to be cristal clear: there is a build but is not perfect. We prefer that the project on which we have worked so lovingly over the last three months comes out in the best possible way.

For this reason we are forced to extend the release dato by two weeks. 

Thanks.

Chapatriste Team.
